system.name: LH-VLN (NavGen, LHPR-VLN, MGDM)
system.one_liner: A long-horizon vision-language navigation task with a data-generation platform (NavGen), a benchmark (LHPR-VLN) and a chain-of-thought plus memory navigation model.

content.variant_note: the task drawn on a floor plan next to three prior task cards, plus a right-hand column of three mini diagrams for platform, benchmark and model
content.argues: Navigation chained over several sub-tasks is a new task: each existing task covers one stage, so a new platform, benchmark and memory model are needed.
content.subject: A house floor plan with staged routes, a long instruction split into four sub-tasks, three short-task cards, and mini diagrams of NavGen, the benchmark chain and the CoT-memory model.

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw a new task that chains older tasks as one coloured route on a scene render, give each older task the colour of its segment, and tie each segment to its own small card with a leader line. Stack the platform, benchmark and model as three titled mini diagrams in one column.
lessons.suits: A paper that introduces a task combining earlier tasks and also ships a data platform, a benchmark and a model, with real scene images to show.

evidence: Caption: LH-VLN divides navigation into several sub-tasks that the agent completes in sequence within the scene.
Caption: the data generation framework, the LHPR-VLN benchmark and a CoT-and-memory navigation model are the three parts shown.
Introduction: three components are named, a data generation platform, a benchmark and a specialised method with adaptive memory.

summary: The paper proposes long-horizon vision-language navigation (LH-VLN), with a data-generation platform (NavGen), a benchmark (LHPR-VLN) and a navigation model that uses chain-of-thought and short- and long-term memory. Figure 1 is a composite. A top-down render of a house carries a dark-blue route through four stages, while grey, gold and green leader lines link single stages to small cards of three existing tasks (object localization, demand-driven, instruction-following navigation). A blue panel shows one long instruction cut into four sub-task cards with room photos. A right-hand column stacks three mini diagrams: NavGen producing Move-to steps with a GPT logo, the benchmark chain with weights, and the CoT, observation and memory model. Bold serif labels on rounded colour-matched frames.
summary_zh: 提出长程视觉语言导航任务，配套数据生成平台NavGen、基准LHPR-VLN和带思维链与记忆的导航模型。左侧用房屋俯视图和彩色路线说明四阶段任务，并与三种既有导航任务卡片对照；右侧三个小图依次画出数据生成、基准任务链和模型。
notes: Prior pass said scope-overview / benchmark-dashboard; the figure has no statistics or taxonomy, so it is a contribution mosaic (platform, benchmark, model) with a task comparison on the left; the three small task cards act as a mild example gallery. The text layer of the SVG digest is garbled, so labels were read from the preview. The meaning of the grey circles 1 and 1/n, the circled plus and Memory & Fuzzy is not supported by the visible text. The bottom caption text is partly cropped into the preview and was ignored.
